newsitem.title: UK: IBCA rates Thai Military Bk C/D individual.
newsitem.headline: IBCA rates Thai Military Bk C/D individual.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Wednesday it assigned an individual rating of C/D and a legal rating of 2 to Thai Military Bank, Thailand's sixth largest commercial bank.

"Thai Military Bank's rating reflects its performance, capital strength and asset quality. It also takes into account the possible adverse effects of the country's economic slowdown on the bank's already questionable asset quality," IBCA said in a statement.
"Thai Military Bank maintains strong links to the military in terms of ownership but is operationally independent of its major shareholders," the agency said.

"Notwithstanding the vibrance of Thailand's economic environment over the past decade, the bank's experience with non-performing loans has not been good, although improvement in the past four years has been significant," IBCA said.
It said non-performing loans amounted to 23 percent of total loans in 1991 but had fallen to 11.5 percent by December 1995, a level that still remained high by both Thai and international standards.

"Thailand's economic slowdown may impede the progress made in terms of improving the quality of Thai Military Bank's loan book. The bank's provisioning is not much greater than the Bank of Thailand's minimum requirement and therefore Thai Military Bank's future profitability could be affected to a greater extent than that of some it peers," IBCA said.
